title: Adult clinical seizure-event detection
scientific_question: Can a neural detector identify ictal intervals in new Siena patients despite heterogeneous channels and clock annotations?
primary_outputs: Per-sample scores and event intervals for complete selected recordings.

recording_contract.neural: Representative EDF header: 35 channels at 512 Hz, including 29 labeled EEG channels plus EKG/SPO2/HR/auxiliary/marker channels; 2,625 one-second records. Neural-only input must exclude auxiliary and MK channels.
recording_contract.labels: 14-row subject_info.csv records patient ID, age, sex, seizure type, localization/lateralization, EEG channel count and seizure count; event files give clock-based seizure starts/ends. Counts sum to 47 seizures.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Subtract registration start from seizure clock, handling day wrap and known source corrections. Actual PN00-1 event is 1143–1213 s. PN00-3 source has an impossible one-hour-long end-time typo; official parser corrects end time to18.29.29 and handles other filename/spacing exceptions.
recording_contract.biological_ids: 14 independent PN patient identifiers, with multiple files per patient; all files remain grouped. This is a separate adult cohort from pediatric CHB-MIT, not a processed CHB subset.
recording_contract.evidence: 41-file manifest, 14-row subject table, actual event text, 9,216-byte EDF header and source correction/annotation parser inspected; no signal samples downloaded.

case_definition: One isolated biological-unit/session packet under the split policy; multiple scored observations are nested items, not independent biological cases.

split.policy: Group complete PN patient recordings; cross-cohort task uses CHB training and Siena confirmation with a locked channel/calibration policy.
split.uncertainty: Biological-unit paired uncertainty where multiple units exist; single-animal/person tasks use descriptive session/trial blocks and do not imply population replication.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Patient-macro event F1; mandatory false alarms per 24 hours and sensitivity.

evaluation.comparability: Task variants and related outcomes share source/family evidence. Never sum task counts as independent cohorts or average unlike native metrics.
